description: What `mvn <command>` would actually run in THIS project, without running Maven: module by module (reactor order with -pl/-am/-amd), phase by phase, goal by goal, and WHERE each goal comes from — the packaging default binding, your pom (with line), the parent (e.g. spring-boot:repackage comes from spring-boot-starter-parent), or a profile. Also: what is declared but never runs and why, which profiles are active and why, what changes between Maven 3.10 and 4.0, and a pom review (duplicates that fail the build since 3.10, plugins without a version). Verified goal by goal against real `mvn` logs (Maven 3.10.0 and 4.0.0-rc-7) on 11 real cases. Unknown parents or plugins are reported, never guessed.

command.description: The command, e.g. "mvn -pl api -am clean install -DskipTests -Pprod". Default: "mvn clean package"

jdk.description: JDK major version, for <activation><jdk> profiles. Default 21

maven.description: Maven version to simulate: 3 (3.10) or 4 (4.0). Default 3

pom.description: A single pom.xml pasted, if there is no folder

project.description: Project folder: every pom.xml in it is read (target/ and node_modules/ skipped)

name: maven_plan
